name: oak
notes: 3D map woods (owner 2026-10-10: 树木的品种过于单一，请根据不同的地理环境生成不同树木的模型): the species a CLUMP is planted as, picked per clump by tools/map3d/bake_trees.py from the ground's biome shares (biomes: id:weight), its height (h_gain: how much more it scores per share of the tree line, negative = a lowland tree), a slow noise per species (map3d_trees.csv species_wave_m: patches of one kind inside a mixed wood) and weight; habit is where it is planted (wood, lone, hedge, bank); form broad or conifer (the 3D crowns' shape and woods.png's conifer share); cells the crown atlas cells it wears (data/map3d_tree_crowns.csv); crowns per clump, spread_m their reach from the clump's middle, size the crowns' size; tint_lo..tint_hi the per-clump tint range (sRGB, only its hue counts: tree_card.gdshader divides by the mean). An enabled 0 row waits for its atlas art. Oak: the lowland broadleaf, olive and warm
